title: Follow me [Cobblemon]
description: This modification makes your Pokemon follow you like in Gen 2 remake games!
body:
# Follow Me (Cobblemon Addon)

Follow me is a client/server addon which allows your pokemon to follow you like in Gen2 remake games!

### ✨ Features
* **Smooth Following System:** Pokémon now dynamically adjust their speed to smoothly catch up to you. They will gracefully walk or run behind you.
* **Interactive Feeding:** Hold an **Apple** or **Sweet Berries**, and your out-of-ball team will smoothly surround you in a circle. 
* **Friendship Boosts:** Right-click with an Apple/Berries in your main hand to feed your entire active team! Each Pokémon gets **+2 Friendship** *(Balanced for survival: maximum 7 times per Minecraft day).*
* **Secret Easter Egg:** Have exactly 6 Clefairies out of their Pokéballs and double-tap the toggle key...

### 🎮 Controls
* Press **`** (Grave Accent / Tilde) to toggle the "Follow Me" mode ON or OFF. When OFF, Pokémon revert to their vanilla Cobblemon AI.

## ⚙️ Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Dependencies:**
  * Fabric API
  * Cobblemon (tested on version 1.7.1)



**For suggestions and bug reports you can contact me here:** https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1516820187008077967
